import sys,copy,json
sys.path.insert(0,'submission')
from common import validate,Invalid
BASE={'version':3,'seed':'s','leases':[],'services':[],'queries':[0],'captures':[],'requests':[],'offers':[],'request_quotas':[],'offer_quotas':[]}
def tryv(label,j,expect):
 try: validate(j); got=True
 except Invalid: got=False
 print(('OK ' if got==expect else 'FAIL '),label,got)
 return got==expect
ok=True
for n,e in [(24,True),(25,False)]:
 j=copy.deepcopy(BASE);j['seed']='a'*n;ok&=tryv(f'id len {n}',j,e)
# times
for t,e in [(0,True),(10**12,True),(10**12+1,False),(-1,False)]:
 j=copy.deepcopy(BASE);j['queries']=[t];ok&=tryv(f'query {t}',j,e)
for end,e in [(1,True),(10**12+1,True),(10**12+2,False)]:
 j=copy.deepcopy(BASE);j['queries']=[0];j['leases']=[{'id':'l','prefix':'2001:db8::/64','start':0,'end':end,'subnets':[0],'low_count':1}];ok&=tryv(f'lease end {end}',j,e)
# prefix lengths
for pl,e in [(56,True),(64,True),(55,False),(65,False),(32,False)]:
 j=copy.deepcopy(BASE);j['leases']=[{'id':'l','prefix':f'2001:db8::/{pl}','start':0,'end':1,'subnets':[0],'low_count':1}];ok&=tryv(f'lease /{pl}',j,e)
# subnet bounds /56
for sub,e in [(0,True),(255,True),(256,False)]:
 j=copy.deepcopy(BASE);j['leases']=[{'id':'l','prefix':'2001:db8::/56','start':0,'end':1,'subnets':[sub],'low_count':1}];ok&=tryv(f'subnet {sub}',j,e)
# low_count bounds
for lc,e in [(1,True),(32,True),(0,False),(33,False)]:
 j=copy.deepcopy(BASE);j['leases']=[{'id':'l','prefix':'2001:db8::/64','start':0,'end':1,'subnets':[0],'low_count':lc}];ok&=tryv(f'low_count {lc}',j,e)
# offer prefix lengths
for pl,e in [(32,True),(128,True),(31,False),(33,True)]:
 j=copy.deepcopy(BASE);j['offers']=[{'id':'o','time':0,'service':'s','prefix':f'2001:db8::/{pl}','capacity':0,'cost':0,'group':'q','requests':[]}];j['services']=[{'id':'s','kind':'tcp'}];j['offer_quotas']=[{'id':'q','parent':None,'capacity':1}];ok&=tryv(f'offer /{pl}',j,e)
# capacity/cost bounds
for cap,e in [(0,True),(4096,True),(4097,False),(-1,False)]:
 j=copy.deepcopy(BASE);j['services']=[{'id':'s','kind':'tcp'}];j['offer_quotas']=[{'id':'q','parent':None,'capacity':1}];j['offers']=[{'id':'o','time':0,'service':'s','prefix':'2001:db8::/32','capacity':cap,'cost':0,'group':'q','requests':[]}];ok&=tryv(f'offer cap {cap}',j,e)
